Claim 26 (Currently Amended): A non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by at least one processing unit analyzes a document, the program comprising sets of instructions for: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document, the document having a drawing order that indicates the order in which the primitive graphic elements are drawn when the document is displayed; calculating a first value for a first primitive graphic element and a second primitive graphic element that is subsequent to the first in the drawing order; and based on the comparison of the first value to other values calculated for additional primitive graphic elements that are subsequent in the drawing order, defining a single structural graphic element within the document from the first and second primitive graphic elements, wherein the comparison comprises determining a relationship between the first value and other values.

Claim 27 (Currently Amended): The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the first value is a size value, the size value calculated from specific characteristics of the first primitive graphic element.

Claim 32 (Currently Amended): A non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by at least one processing unit analyzes a document, the program comprising sets of instructions for: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document; based on values calculated for pairs of primitive graphic elements, defining a set of successive primitive graphic elements as a candidate compound graphic element; using bounds of the primitive graphic elements to identify one or more subsets of primitive graphic elements within the set; and defining each particular subset having more than one primitive graphic element as a single structural graphic element within the document, the structure graphic element including, but not limited to, the primitive graphic elements in the particular subset.

Claim 37 (Currently Amended): A method for analyzing a document, the method comprising: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document, the document having a drawing order that indicates the order in which the primitive graphic elements are drawn when the document is displayed; calculating a first value for a first primitive graphic element and a second primitive graphic element that is subsequent to the first in the drawing order; and based on the comparison of the first value to other values calculated for additional primitive graphic elements that are subsequent in the drawing order, defining a single structural graphic element within the document from the first and second primitive graphic elements, wherein the comparison comprises determining a relationship between the first value and other calculated values.

Claim 41 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 37, wherein the calculating comprises calculating a different value for each pair of primitive graphic elements subsequent in the drawing order, and wherein defining the single structural graphic element further comprises: using the calculated values for pairs of primitive graphic elements to identify clusters of primitive graphic elements as candidates for joining as compound graphic elements; identifying sequences of primitive graphic elements within a cluster whose bounding boxes intersect; and joining the sequences as single graphic elements while evaluating overlapping relationships of the bounding boxes.
